skillset.skill: 14s CT - 6000% Dark DMG (PHY). Increase own Arts by 30.
skillset.arts: 28000% Dark DMG (PHY). For 25s, increase allies' Paralysis RES and Freeze RES by 100%. Additionally when used for the first time, increase allies' Arts by 100 and Demon allies' Arts by 100.
skillset.truearts: 65000% Dark DMG (PHY). For 45s, reduce enemies' Dark RES by 80% (stackable).
skillset.superarts: 220000% Dark DMG (PHY). For 20s, increase own DMG the higher own current HP is (MAX: 300%).

passive.ability1: When own HP is above 80%, increase own Accuracy by 50%.
passive.ability2: When own HP is above 50%, ignores enemies' DEF by 100%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. Increase DMG to Human Enemies by 40%.
passive.ability3: Increase Dark allies' BE Output by 10%.
passive.ability4: Unit EXP UP 20% UP. (When Jiji's SP. Art is owned)
passive.ability5: At the Start of Quest, increase own Arts gauge by 10. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. (When Jiji's SP. Art is owned)
